philosophy.heading: A substance that causes symptoms, in minute doses, can help resolve those same symptoms.
philosophy.paragraph1: Homeopathy treats each person as a unique individual, aiming to stimulate the body's own natural healing ability. The right remedy is chosen by matching the whole pattern of a person's symptoms — physical, emotional, and lifestyle — not just a diagnosis.
philosophy.paragraph2: Chopping an onion causes watery eyes and a runny nose. In homeopathy, a preparation made from onion (Allium cepa) may be chosen for someone whose symptoms closely resemble that same pattern. It's medicine built on the principle of similarity.
philosophy.quote: In every drop, a dose of nature's wisdom. In every remedy, the promise of gentle healing.

medicalNotice.title: Important Medical Notice
medicalNotice.text: Homeopathy is considered a complementary therapy. Scientific evidence supporting its effectiveness for many medical conditions is limited, and it should not replace conventional medical care, especially for serious or emergency conditions. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional regarding your health concerns.

items.question: What is homeopathy and how does it work?
items.answer: Homeopathy is a system of medicine based on the principle of "like cures like" — a substance that can cause symptoms in a healthy person may, in a highly diluted form, help the body address similar symptoms. Remedies are chosen to match your overall pattern of symptoms, not just a diagnosis.

items.question: How do online consultations work?
items.answer: Consultations take place over Zoom or WhatsApp video. The first session runs 60–90 minutes so we can go through your concerns in full; follow-ups run 30–45 minutes to track progress and adjust your plan.

items.question: Is homeopathy safe for children and pregnant women?
items.answer: Homeopathic remedies are generally considered gentle, but every case is individual — especially during pregnancy or for young children. This is discussed in detail during your consultation, and I'll always advise seeing a doctor for anything requiring urgent or emergency care.

items.question: How long does treatment take to show results?
items.answer: This varies by person and condition. Some notice changes within a few weeks; longer-standing concerns can take longer. Follow-up sessions are built in specifically to track progress and adjust the plan as needed.

items.question: Can I take homeopathic medicine alongside conventional treatment?
items.answer: In many cases, yes — but please tell me about any medications or treatments you're currently using so I can take that into account. Never stop a prescribed conventional treatment without speaking to the prescribing doctor first.

items.question: What are the consultation fees?
items.answer: Fees depend on the type and length of consultation. Message on WhatsApp or fill out the booking form and I'll confirm pricing before we schedule anything.
